claims.answer: Product-provided list_agents/send_message tools let one session find and message another; idle recipients wake and busy recipients receive mid-turn messages. Reemoat supplies inter-session MCP delegation/communication, including passing a task to a peer and getting its answer. This is delegation to existing sessions, not a claimed automatic parent/child planning tree. A peer can answer the originating session, across harnesses/machines; the relay encrypts cross-machine messages. No broader retained-result guarantee is inferred.

claims.answer: macOS client includes a daemon for work on that Mac. Agent execution uses user files and Git on the chosen machine. A daemon on user-owned Linux/server or Mac machines runs agents; native clients connect through encrypted relay channels. All core pieces, including daemon, control plane and relay, can run on user-owned infrastructure. Optional hosted control plane is not vendor-provided agent compute. README explicitly says the daemon remains authoritative when the supervisory laptop lid closes or phone link changes. This is continuation on another running host; it does not keep a sleeping execution host alive.

sources.finding: Documents native desktop/Android supervision, user-owned execution, per-session worktrees, peer messaging, full self-hosting and explicitly no sandbox/no browser work client.

sources.title: Reemoat src/acp/agents.ts
sources.finding: Exact launch resolution: claude-agent-acp and codex-acp require their native CLIs; kimi/opencode use acp, Grok uses agent stdio and cursor-agent uses acp. Native login/API-key caveats are explicit.

sources.title: Reemoat docs/NATIVE.md
sources.locator: What runs where platform table lines27-37; no browser client rationale
sources.finding: Native platform table is stale/conflicting with README release assets for Linux, Windows and Android. It explicitly refuses iOS client build and Windows daemon hosting. Scope must preserve the discrepancy.

sources.title: Reemoat packages/web/src/ui/DiffView.tsx
sources.finding: Transcript edit card displays actual proposed hunks and line.text with add/delete styling, not only file counts.

sources.title: Reemoat packages/web/src/legal/privacy.ts
sources.locator: No analytics and no third-party scripts section
sources.finding: Policy source explicitly says no analytics/session recorder/advertising network or tracking scripts. This statement does not substitute for auditing every native/daemon telemetry path.

sources.title: Reemoat LICENSE
sources.locator: AGPL version3; README License grant scope
sources.finding: Main project license text is AGPLv3, with README explicit AGPL-3.0-only grant. Third-party dependency exceptions remain separate.
